title: One shared business model
supabiz_proposal: Represent people, businesses, matters, orders, receipts, invoices and tasks as typed records with stable IDs. Chat, dashboards and agents consume the same authorized projections. Start with one workflow, not a universal ontology.
measure: Record agreement across interfaces; incorrect joins

title: Align meaning before matching
supabiz_proposal: Compare only compatible business, entity, unit, currency, period and fact type. Received quantity and invoiced quantity are distinct facts, even when they differ. Keep conversion rules and source ancestry explicit.
measure: Wrong-entity and wrong-unit matches; unresolved match rate

title: Preserve observations and corrections
supabiz_proposal: Keep immutable evidence revisions and a versioned current projection. Store occurred_at, observed_at, ingested_at and effective period. A corrected notice supersedes a claim without deleting the earlier evidence.
measure: Reproducible as-of views; stale-source mistakes

title: Three check outcomes, separate job states
supabiz_proposal: A check can pass, fail, or remain unverified. Workflow completion, review decision and delivery status are independent dimensions. Display the reason and next responsible person.
measure: False passes on missing data; correctly classified failures

title: Exact rules for exact questions
supabiz_proposal: Use validated decimal/integer arithmetic, explicit units and versioned rules for quantities, totals, duplicate keys and permissions. OCR confidence, legal meaning and visual cleanliness need their own uncertainty or review path.
measure: Arithmetic errors; rule coverage; perception errors kept separate

title: Approval records do not rewrite facts
supabiz_proposal: Bind approval to tenant, actor, action digest, record version, policy version and expiry. A reviewer may authorize a permitted exception with a reason; preserve the failed check and original evidence. Recheck identity and grants at execution.
measure: Stale approvals blocked; unexplained overrides

title: A work item with an evidence drawer
supabiz_proposal: Show the proposed field change beside the original photo, audio timecode, email attachment or PDF page, with freshness and conflicts. Make every queue item lead to a resolution action and named owner.
measure: Review time; evidence-open rate; orphaned exceptions

title: Useful uncertainty rather than a dead end
supabiz_proposal: State exactly what is missing and request only the evidence needed: received weight, clearer invoice line, or confirmation of the matter. Limit reminders and use a single evolving work item.
measure: Clarification count; exception age; unnecessary interruptions

title: Rules and mappings are reviewed versions
supabiz_proposal: Translate a plain-language SOP into a draft typed workflow. Show scope, trigger, data access, checks, approvals and effects; simulate it, publish a version, and support rollback. Staff corrections remain local proposals until reviewed.
measure: Time to safe activation; rule regressions

title: Persistent state, replaceable workers
supabiz_proposal: Keep records, evidence, runs and policy in SupaBiz-owned durable services. Give workers only bounded task context and short-lived capabilities. Persistent desktops may serve browser tasks but should not be the business system of record.
measure: Context bytes per task; worker recovery; unauthorized fields exposed

title: Read-only onboarding, separate action gateway
supabiz_proposal: Begin a pilot with observation and drafts. Enable specific internal writes and external effects progressively through a policy-enforcing action service, scoped credentials and effect receipts. A read permission is not send permission.
measure: Time to first reviewed value; unauthorized or duplicate effects

title: Telemetry is not authorization
supabiz_proposal: Record intended action before an effect, but enforce grants independently. If completion logging fails after an upstream commit, mark outcome uncertain and reconcile before retrying. Never treat a logging gateway as a permission boundary.
measure: Unrecorded intent; uncertain outcomes recovered without duplicates

title: Independent, portable evidence
supabiz_proposal: Make results exportable with input references, rule versions, decisions and hashes. Add signatures and external checkpoints when justified. Verify trusted keys independently; proof integrity does not establish factual truth or population completeness.
measure: Offline verification; tamper detection; export completeness

title: Freshness and completeness are first-class
supabiz_proposal: Record source watermarks, lag, gaps, reconnect state and expected coverage. A disconnected WhatsApp session must visibly limit a summary. An empty successful fetch differs from a failed or partial fetch.
measure: Missing-event detection; stale summaries; p95 ingestion lag

title: Replayable events, idempotent consumers
supabiz_proposal: Use a transactional outbox and tenant-scoped event IDs; consumers record dedupe and object revisions. Out-of-order events cannot roll back current state. Delivery retries never mean the underlying business action should repeat.
measure: Duplicate effects; out-of-order regressions; delivery lag

title: Model choice is a measured substitution
supabiz_proposal: Try a cheaper model for constrained extraction or explanation under the same input and rule contracts. Compare held-out complete workflows including corrections, review time and missed exceptions before routing production traffic.
measure: Cost per correct completed workflow; false acceptance; abstention

title: Tenant isolation extends into every output
supabiz_proposal: Enforce business and matter grants in retrieval, object downloads, exports, notifications, caches and execution. Sign-in establishes identity; active membership and resource scope establish access. Keep model context and logs minimal.
measure: Cross-business/matter disclosure; revocation latency

title: Bind approvals to current state
supabiz_proposal: Use optimistic version checks so two reviewers cannot silently overwrite one another. If evidence or intended recipients change, invalidate the pending approval and explain the difference before another decision.
measure: Lost updates; approval conflicts; action-version mismatch

title: Verify package identity and compatibility
supabiz_proposal: Pin publisher, registry, digest, API schema and tested capabilities. Prefer scoped package names. Block setup on identity mismatch, and retain the failure reason. Do not execute an arbitrary same-name package from documentation.
measure: Incorrect package acceptance; SDK/API drift caught before rollout

title: Start with a small record-and-verification core
supabiz_proposal: Build one receipt/invoice workflow and one notice/task workflow using a relational record store, object storage and a job queue. Add advanced proof infrastructure, dedicated tenant deployments or generalized workflow builders only after measured demand.
measure: Time to verified pilot; operational cost; migration burden
